correctness.rationale: The simplex envelope has center S/(m+1)1 and covariance S²/[m(m+1)](I-J/(m+1)); subset-indicator support is S/(m+1)[s+sqrt{s(m+1-s)/m}]. For m>=n, direct comparison with B_s=s(2n-s+1)/2 is valid for every cardinality; strict support yields only lower and total contacts for m>n, with singleton upper touches at m=n. For 2<=m<n, max coordinate=2S/(m+1)>n so the simplex ellipsoid cannot be the John ellipsoid. Unique enclosing-simplex optimum yields strict volume loss, with m=1 an interval exception. Independent exact rational support checks on (m,n)=(1,5),(2,4),(3,3),(6,3),(12,8) matched the boundary.
